fn Replace(arr: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(arr) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(arr))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(arr): ((not (arr[i] > k)) or (result[i] == -1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(arr): ((not (arr[i] <= k)) or (result[i] == arr[i]))
  effects pure
  example (Replace([], 0) == [])
